title: MWCC 1.2.5 register-allocator notes
description: Validated working model of the MWCC GC/1.2.5 optimizer and register allocator: pass pipelines per -O level, spill-cost formula, simplify/select ordering, a table of source-level levers proven to move register assignments, a taxonomy of residual mismatches that are NOT source-steerable, and symptom-to-pipeline-stage attribution. Primary use: register-swap mismatch plateaus. Melee ships GC/1.2.5n, which the document verifies is byte-identical to stock 1.2.5 in the optimizer and register-coloring regions.
